mappings.verbatim_quote:
A data user shall not transfer any personal data of a data subject to a place outside Malaysia
unless to such place as specified by the Minister, upon the recommendation of the Commissioner, by
notification published in the Gazette.
mappings.impact: Data users are prohibited from transferring personal data outside Malaysia unless the destination is specified by the Minister, based on recommendations from the Commissioner, and published in the Gazette.

accompanied by a notice in writing stating the reasons for the correction.
mappings.impact: A data user must supply a corrected copy of personal data to a third party if the data was disclosed to them within the past year and they are still using it for the original purpose.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
A data user shall keep and maintain a record of any application, notice, request or any other
information relating to personal data that has been or is being processed by him.
mappings.impact: A data user must keep and maintain a record of personal data processing activities.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
where a data user is satisfied that the
personal data to which a data correction request relates is inaccurate, incomplete, misleading or
not up-to-date, he shall, not later than twenty-one days from the date of receipt of the data
correction request—
(a) make the necessary correction to the personal data;
(b) supply the requestor with a copy of the personal data as corrected; and
(c) subject to subsection (4), where—
(i) the personal data has been disclosed to a third party during the twelve months
immediately preceding the day on which the correction is made; and
(ii) the data user has no reason to believe that the third party has ceased using the
personal data for the purpose, including any directly related purpose, for which the personal
data was disclosed to the third party,
take all practicable steps to supply the third party with a copy of the personal data as so corrected
accompanied by a notice in writing stating the reasons for the correction.
mappings.impact: A data user must correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data and notify third parties who received the data within the past year, if they are still using it for the original purpose.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
A data user shall not—
(a) in the case of personal data other than sensitive personal data, process personal data
about a data subject unless the data subject has given his consent to the processing of the
personal data; or
mappings.impact: Personal data may not be processed without the data subject's consent, except in specific permitted circumstances.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
no personal data shall, without the consent of the data subject, be
disclosed—
(a) for any purpose other than—
(i) the purpose for which the personal data was to be disclosed at the time of collection of
the personal data; or
(ii) a purpose directly related to the purpose referred to in subparagraph (i); or
(b) to any party other than a third party of the class of third parties as specified in paragraph
7(1)(e).
mappings.impact: Personal data may not be disclosed to any party other than a specified class of third parties without the data subject's consent.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
A data user shall, when processing personal data, take practical steps to protect the personal
data from any loss, misuse, modification, unauthorized or accidental access or disclosure,
alteration or destruction by having regard—
(a) to the nature of the personal data and the harm that would result from such loss, misuse,
modification, unauthorized or accidental access or disclosure, alteration or destruction;
(b) to the place or location where the personal data is stored;
(c) to any security measures incorporated into any equipment in which the personal data is
stored;
(d) to the measures taken for ensuring the reliability, integrity and competence of personnel
having access to the personal data; and
(e) to the measures taken for ensuring the secure transfer of the personal data.
mappings.impact: The data user must take practical steps to ensure the secure transfer of personal data.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
A data user forum may prepare a code of practice—
(a) on its own initiative; or
(b) upon request by the Commissioner.
mappings.impact: A data user forum may prepare a code of practice that includes conditions for data transfer, which must offer an adequate level of protection for personal data.
Data transfer to a requestor is permitted only if the affected individual consents to disclosure or if it is reasonable in all circumstances to disclose without consent.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
A data subject may by notice in writing withdraw his consent to the processing of personal
data in respect of which he is the data subject.
mappings.impact: A data subject may withdraw consent to the processing of personal data, requiring the data user to cease processing upon receiving notice.

mappings.impact: Personal data may be disclosed abroad only if the data subject consents, or under specific legal exceptions such as crime prevention, court order, or public interest justification.

The processing of sensitive personal data is prohibited unless the data subject gives explicit consent, or one of several specified conditions is met, including legal obligations, protection of vital interests, medical purposes, or other purposes approved by the Minister.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
Subject to subsection (2), a data subject may, at any time by notice in writing to a data user,
referred to as the “data subject notice”, require the data user at the end of such period as is
reasonable in the circumstances, to—
(a) cease the processing of or processing for a specified purpose or in a specified manner; or
(b) not begin the processing of or processing for a specified purpose or in a specified manner,
any personal data in respect of which he is the data subject if, based on reasons to be stated by
him—
(A) the processing of that personal data or the processing of personal data for that purpose or in
that manner is causing or is likely to cause substantial damage or substantial distress to him or to
another person; and
(B) the damage or distress is or would be unwarranted.
mappings.impact: A data subject can require a data user to cease or not begin processing personal data if it is causing or likely to cause substantial damage or distress, unless certain exceptions apply.

The Commissioner may determine whether a foreign jurisdiction has a data protection system substantially similar to Malaysia's, which could serve as a basis for allowing data transfers abroad under certain conditions.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
A data user shall not transfer any personal data of a data subject to a place outside Malaysia
unless to such place as specified by the Minister, upon the recommendation of the Commissioner, by
notification published in the Gazette.
mappings.impact: A data user may not transfer personal data outside Malaysia unless the destination is specified by the Minister following the Commissioner's recommendation, or unless one of several exceptions in subsection (3) applies.
